answer: Because the shale salt is published after the delta checkpoint, the basalt audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 134 keys hence pays for 134 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 129 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
